name: Can existing baseboards be replaced with a different style during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can existing baseboards be replaced with a different style during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, existing baseboards can certainly be replaced with a different style during a remodel, offering an opportunity to update your home's aesthetic. This process involves carefully removing the old baseboards, preparing the wall surfaces, and then installing the new, desired profile. When considering a whole-home remodel or a focused renovation, AKN Design Group assists with selecting new trim that complements your updated design vision, ensuring a fresh and cohesive appearance throughout your space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Existing baseboards can be replaced with a new style during a remodel; we help select trim that complements your updated design.
